thread:
dylan-cs: Hey team — noticed my org's credits got bumped down after we downgraded the plan yesterday. The invoice charges look higher than expected and the dashboard shows a different remaining credit balance. Can someone help triage?

maria-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the org id and a screenshot of the dashboard vs invoice?

dylan-cs: Org: org_8F3kL. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/a/xxxx (redacted for thread). Invoice id: inv_2024_1234. Dashboard shows 1,200 free-tier credits remaining, invoice math implies 200 remaining.

leo-billing: Thanks. Two quick Qs: did you have any active promo codes or multiple subscriptions across teams? Sometimes credits are allocated per billing account.

dylan-cs: We had an annual commitment converted to monthly yesterday plus a small promo (promo_35OFF) applied to one sub-account. We downgraded the org-wide plan from Dedicated-Large to Dedicated-Small around 2024-09-18 22:14 UTC. No other promos.

eng-usage: tagging with usage team — possible race on credit ordering when subscription changes. Can you share a sample API call that incurred the large token usage and approximate timestamps?

dylan-cs: Most traffic is from a background job hitting the chat endpoint. Example call at 2024-09-18T22:10:45Z:```\nPOST /v1/chat/completions\nAuthorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\n{\n  "model": "redwood-3b",\n  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"expand: summarize meeting notes"}],\n  "max_tokens": 1500\n}\n```We had a spike 22:10-22:16 UTC of ~45k tokens.

billing-bot: [system] Billing ledger update applied: promo_35OFF consumed at 2024-09-18T22:15:03Z; free_tier allocation rebalanced at 2024-09-18T22:15:06Z.

maria-support: OK — initial hypothesis: order of credit consumption changed during the subscription change so the spike consumed premium/paid credits before promo credits were applied. That would make invoice show more usage billed and dashboard free-tier count off.

dylan-cs: That would explain it, but promo was supposed to be prioritized per our contract. We relied on promo credits first, then free-tier, then paid.

leo-billing: Understood. I'll pull the ledger entries and mapping for org_8F3kL. If the promo redemption timestamp is after the usage event, ledger may have backfilled incorrectly.

eng-usage: Quick repro attempt: we have an internal script that simulates subscribe->downgrade->traffic. Reproduced a scenario where allocation reordering happens when plan change and promo apply are concurrent. Filing a bug.

maria-support: Action items: (1) leo to gather ledger + invoice reconciliation for inv_2024_1234; (2) eng-usage to provide a minimal repro and priority patch if race confirmed; (3) support to issue temporary credit adjustment to make customer whole while we investigate.

leo-billing: I'm attaching the ledger snippet (redacted) — shows entries:
```\n2024-09-18T22:10:45Z usage org_8F3kL +45000 tokens -> deducted from paid_pool: -45000\n2024-09-18T22:15:03Z promo_apply promo_35OFF -> +50000 promo_tokens\n2024-09-18T22:15:06Z rebalance free_tier -> set remaining to 1200\n```

eng-usage: That sequence is consistent with the bug: usage was consumed before promo_apply. The intended flow is atomic: promotions attached to billing account should be retroactively applied to concurrent usage within the same billing period if the promo apply timestamp <= cutoff. Looks like our promo-apply job ran slightly after usage and the ledger consumer didn't retroactively reassign tokens.

maria-support: Dylan — we can credit your account 45k tokens (promo-equivalent) pending fix. Would you like a manual adjustment now?

dylan-cs: Yes please — that will unblock us. Also can you confirm the long-term fix ETA? We rely on promo priority for forecasting.

leo-billing: Manual credit issued: adjustment_adj_7654 at 2024-09-19T01:02:10Z -> +45000 promo-equivalent tokens. You should see invoice updated within 10 minutes.

billing-bot: [system] Adjustment applied to org_8F3kL: adjustment_adj_7654; invoice inv_2024_1234 updated to reflect credit refund.

dylan-cs: I see the credit reflected now, thank you.

eng-usage: We'll implement a hotfix that ensures promo application is transactional with ledger reconciliation; target patch in next deploy window (48 hours). Post-mortem to follow with root cause and test coverage.

maria-support: Closing loop once patch is live; we'll also broaden monitoring to detect promo-usage ordering anomalies. Thanks for the quick report and patience. :thumbsup:

dylan-cs: Appreciate it. One suggestion: expose a small API endpoint to show credit priority/order per org — would have saved a bit of back-and-forth.

leo-billing: Good idea, we'll add a request to product backlog.

maria-support: marking thread resolved for now — reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
